mobwalk.config.generic.comment.showSurfa: Whether to draw walkable surfaces: Never (rendering disabled), While Holding Wand (in either hand), or Always.
mobwalk.config.generic.comment.wandItem:
Item id of the wand tool. Defaults to minecraft:stick. Right-click with a wand to select an area.
It is recommended to use a non-interaction item (eg stick, ingot) to prevent action conflicts on right-click.
mobwalk.config.generic.comment.mobProfil: Which mob's hitbox and vertical reach to use when calculating walkable area. Cycles enabled mob profiles only. Does NOT account for horizontal movement when jumping (ie parkour).
mobwalk.config.generic.comment.floodRadi: How far the selection spreads from the clicked block, in flood steps. Large values may impact performance, especially with a large mob hitbox (must check farther per step).
mobwalk.config.generic.comment.swimmable: If enabled, water and lava are treated as walkable to approximate swimming.
mobwalk.config.generic.comment.fluidEsca:
The max height a mob can escape from a water or lava source block. From empirical testing:
 6/16 = 0.375 seems to match mob pathfinding.
14/16 = 0.875 (soul sand) seems to be the player's max escape height from water.
mobwalk.config.profiles.table.name: Name
mobwalk.config.profiles.comment.builtinP: Select built-in mob profiles (hitbox + vertical reach).
mobwalk.config.profiles.comment.customPr: Add custom mob profiles (hitbox + vertical reach). Names must be unique.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.walkab: Color and transparency of walkable surfaces.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.showBe: If enabled, shows beams through solid blocks.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.showHo: If enabled, draws vertical beams at holes (drops a mob cannot escape).
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.holeBe: Color and transparency of hole beams.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.showWa: If enabled, marks water as a hazard.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.waterH: Color and transparency of water hazard markers.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.showLa: If enabled, marks lava as a hazard.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.lavaHa: Color and transparency of lava hazard markers.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.showSo: If enabled, marks soul sand as a hazard.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.soulSa: Color and transparency of soul sand hazard markers.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.showMa: If enabled, marks magma blocks as a hazard.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.magmaH: Color and transparency of magma hazard markers.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.downSk: How far downward drop skirts hang from walkable edges, in blocks. 0 hides them.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.upward: How tall upward wall-edge markers rise from walkable edges, in blocks. 0 hides them.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.drawOn:
If enabled, draws walkable surfaces on a block's visible face. Mostly affects blocks that have a larger visual size than hitbox, like soul sand, so the drawn surfaces aren't buried.
This does mean the drawn walkable surfaces will not be truly aligned to hitboxes, but you will be able to see all surfaces properly. The actual geometry calculations still use the real hitboxes.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.crouchSeeTh: If enabled, while crouching, shows walkable surfaces through walls.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.crouchScrol: If enabled, while crouching with a wand, scrolling changes the flood radius.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.crouchCycle: If enabled, while crouching with a wand, right-clicking air cycles the mob profile.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.shadeByDept: If enabled, colors surfaces by their breadth-first flood depth from the block you clicked. Mostly for debugging connectivity, as the rainbow hues are distracting.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.showCutoffR: If enabled, shows the outermost flood-radius ring in grey, where the flood stopped before checking those surfaces' neighbors. Grey means unchecked, not unwalkable.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.showPointPr: If enabled, lists the Point built-in profile, which is a debugging tool with unfixed edge cases.
mobwalk.command.dump.counts: flood-debug: merged=%s occluders=%s skirts=%s holes=%s hazards=%s (see latest.log)
